# University of Wyoming Academic Affairs

> > Official resource for UW Academic Affairs, including strategic planning, faculty policies, program review processes, and leadership communications from the Provost's office.

The Office of Academic Affairs at the University of Wyoming oversees academic personnel, institutional planning, and program development across colleges including the College of Engineering and Physical Sciences, College of Arts and Sciences, College of Education, Haub School of Environment and Natural Resources, and School of Energy Resources.

## Key Topics

- University of Wyoming (UW)
- Provost messages and updates
- Academic Affairs administration
- Strategic planning and feedback labs
- Faculty development and personnel
- Program review processes
- Board of Trustees policies
- Enrollment management
- Endowed chairs and professorships
- College of Engineering and Physical Sciences
- College of Arts and Sciences
- Haub School of Environment and Natural Resources
- School of Energy Resources
- HLC accreditation requirements
- University planning calendar

## Office Overview & Leadership

- [About the Office of Academic Affairs](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/index.html): Academic Affairs office overview with staff directory and leadership
- [Strategic Planning 2023+](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/plans/team/index.html): University strategic planning overview with calendar and feedback labs
- [Strategic Plan](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/plans/team/strategic-plan.html): University strategic planning calendar and unit dialog framework

## Faculty Policies & Academic Personnel

- [Faculty-Related Policies and Guidelines](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/academic-personnel/policies-guidelines/index.html): Faculty policies on workload, tenure, and HLC accreditation requirements
- [Chairs, Professorships, and Fellowships](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/academic-personnel/chairs/index.html): Endowed chairs, professorships, and faculty fellows directory
- [Process for Institutional Review of Academic Programs](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/program-review/process.html): Academic program review process under UW Regulation 2-13

- [A Message from the Provost: Week of 10.20.25](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-10-20-2025.html): Provost message on AI education, Global Tech Summit, and Giving Day
- [January 29, 2026; Leading Together: A Message from the Provost](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-01-29-2026.html): Provost update on AI teaching, workplace culture, and budget decisions
- [A Message from the Provost: Week of 1.19.26](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-01-19-2026.html): Spring 2026 updates on WyoRecords digital forms and new certificates
- [A Message from the Provost: Week of 9.22.25](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-09-22-2025.html): Board of Trustees updates on low-producing programs and H1B visas
- [A Message from the Provost: Week of 8.25.25](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-08-25-2025.html): Provost welcome message for AY 2025 and State of University Address
- [Office of the Provost Updates: Week of 7.14.25](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-07-14-2025.html): Leadership appointments including Shelley Dodd and enrollment updates
- [Updates from the Office of the Provost 06-09-2025](https://www.uwyo.edu/acadaffairs/about-us/news/provost-06-09-2025.html): Personnel announcements including J. Scott Turpen and dean searches
